_: Who speaks how (tools/make_voices.py): a description for Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (once per figure and language, then cloned for every line), effects after the voice (radio, machine, pa), a pitch range in Hz for figures whose description alone lands off (several takes, the nearest kept), for a figure that speaks with someone else's voice, that one's name (hero: the hero played).

corvin.describe: A man in his mid-forties with a low, slightly husky baritone. Tired and world-weary, dry understated humour, speaks calmly and quietly, a faint rasp from years on space stations.

dorra.describe: A sturdy woman in her late thirties from a heavy-gravity mining world. Firm, warm alto with a strong chest voice, grounded and blunt, a slight working-class roughness, steady unhurried pace.

ione.describe: A woman around thirty, a precise maintenance technician. Clear mid-range voice, quick and exact articulation, cool and controlled with a hint of dry irony, slightly soft-spoken.

ysolde.describe: A woman in her mid-fifties, a cultivated power broker. Low, smooth mezzo-soprano, measured and persuasive, warm on the surface with steel beneath, precise diction, never raises her voice.

unzu.describe: An ancient surveying machine with a male voice, centuries old. Calm, deliberate and slightly formal, a soft mid-low register, deadpan dry humour, every word weighed.

ruul.describe: A man in his seventies, frail but sharp. A thin, dry, slightly reedy voice, impatient and precise, a scientist who calculates everything and has no time left to waste.

bedauern.describe: The mind of a vast warship, a smooth male-sounding synthetic voice. Very polite, unhurried and soft-spoken, faintly amused, the calm of something that cannot be threatened.

sorge.describe: The mind of a warship, a warm mid-range female-sounding synthetic voice. Cheerful and reassuring like customer service, an uncanny unbroken calm.

patrol.describe: The mind of a patrol ship, a flat male-sounding synthetic voice. Bureaucratic and indifferent, reading out regulations, polite without any interest.

ilka.describe: A nine-year-old girl. A small, quiet and slightly hoarse child's voice, shy and anxious, hesitant, speaks softly.

ilka39.describe: A woman around forty who has led two thousand people for thirty years. Low, clear and calm voice, tired authority, measured and unsentimental, a faint trace of the shy child she once was.

mother.describe: A woman in her fifties, the boss of a gang of mind thieves, copied into seven bodies. A rasping, amused alto, contemptuous and very calm, every word slightly drawn out.

hold.describe: A young man's quiet voice from inside a machine, resigned and very calm, almost gentle.

hale.describe: A woman in her late fifties, a mining director. Hard, controlled alto with a working-class edge under polished authority, firm and unapologetic, a little weary.

arche.describe: An old ship's administration computer with a gentle female-sounding voice. Patient, slow and kindly, a little worn and frail, like an elderly nurse.

kiri.describe: A woman in her forties, a mechanic and tinkerer. Brisk, practical and economical with words, a warm slightly raspy voice, quietly amused.

okafor.describe: A woman in her forties, a military commander. Low, commanding voice, clipped and pragmatic, unsentimental, speaks in short decisive sentences.

kern.describe: A middle-aged man whose mind is trapped in a machine. Utterly exhausted, slow and breathy, almost broken, pleading quietly.

pilot.describe: A woman in her early thirties, a ship's pilot on the intercom. Fast, focused and professional, a clear mid-range voice, tense but controlled.

zoegernd.describe: A timid machine voice, androgynous and soft. Hesitant and uncertain, stammering slightly, apologetic, as if afraid of its own decisions.

lancecore.describe: A young man's voice from inside a machine. Quiet, lost and sad, gentle and slow, as if remembering nothing of who he was.

rigcore.describe: A middle-aged woman's voice from inside a drilling machine. Confused and dreamy, slow and kind, like someone waking from a very long shift.

vorarbeiter.describe: A man in his fifties, a hardened foreman. Gravelly, bitter and aggressive voice, used to shouting over machines, contemptuous and tired.

pell.describe: An old man in his seventies, a lonely scholar. Soft, wondering and slow, a thin voice, speaks with long pauses as if he rarely talks to anyone.

k2281.describe: A young man's voice, a calm tenor, of a cognitive control core. Polite, careful and earnest, gentle, choosing each word.

hausmeister.describe: A station's caretaker computer with a deep male-sounding voice. Flat and mechanical, a steady monotone of status announcements, perfectly precise and literal.

doctor.describe: A tired middle-aged male doctor in a charity clinic. Kind but overworked, calm, low and matter-of-fact.

arena.describe: A male arena announcer with a deep bass voice, speaking into a microphone, smooth and warm like a late-night radio host, amused and unhurried.

funk.describe: A fast-talking salesman on the radio, a man in his thirties with a medium-low male voice. Cheerful hustler, quick and slick, always selling.

ottla.describe: A woman in her sixties who runs a bar. Warm, husky smoker's voice, motherly but tough, has heard every story.

berater.describe: A sweet, overly friendly female-sounding synthetic voice of a body clinic's service. Upbeat, smooth and hollow, smiling all the time.

ausgabe.describe: A cheap vending machine's synthetic voice, androgynous. Chirpy, clipped and robotic, the same cheerful tone for everything.

lamm.describe: A man in his forties, a bored decadent aristocrat and arena champion. Light theatrical tenor, mocking and amused, savouring every word.

mira.describe: An eight-year-old girl. Clear high voice, bold, suspicious and quick, a street-wise child.

kind.describe: A six-year-old boy. High, bright voice, curious and cheerful, a little breathless.

fan.describe: A young woman in her twenties with a low, husky alto, an arena spectator, excited but talking quietly to her neighbour.

leader.describe: A man in his forties with a deep, rough male voice, a pirate boarding leader. Harsh and threatening, cold menace rather than shouting.

siel.describe: A woman in her forties, a military major. Controlled, cool and measured, a low voice of authority with a trace of weariness.

dreier.describe: A man in his sixties, a cynical crime boss. Smooth, sardonic and gravelly, quietly menacing, enjoys his own words.

josse.describe: A man in his forties, a miner. A gentle, warm baritone, singing a slow folk song softly to himself.

brask.describe: A man in his fifties with a low, gruff male voice, a shift supervisor on a call from home. Irritated and bullying, impatient, talking down.

editor.describe: A cold, clinical synthetic voice, androgynous. Soft and calm, chillingly gentle, like a nurse who does not care.

worker.describe: A man in his thirties with a low male voice, a worker. Nervous and hurried, speaking quietly, warning someone.

chief.describe: The commander of a cleaning squad, a cold male-sounding synthetic voice. Flat and precise, regretful in words only.

narrator.describe: A man in his sixties with a deep, warm and calm voice, a chronicler reading the last pages of a long story aloud: measured, unhurried, quietly moved, never dramatic.
